Real-time booking system

ProjectG92 Studios

What was built

  • Follow-up tasks for the team

Workflow automation

Approvals, onboarding and daily briefing

ProjectClient projects

The challengeApprovals, new-user setup and daily summaries took manual effort and were easy to forget.

What was built

  • Approval requests in team chat, decisions logged in a sheet

  • A form that sets up a new user across company tools
  • A daily AI summary of email and calendar delivered to chat

  2. 💬 Approval asked
  3. ✅ Decision

Questions

Questions agencies ask first

Do I need to change the tools I already use?

No need to start from zero. The system connects to where your leads arrive today, and you will be told honestly if anything should change.

Will the replies sound robotic?

Messages are written in your brand's voice and reviewed with you before anything goes live.

What if a lead wants to talk to a person?

The assistant hands the conversation over and your agent gets an instant alert.

How long does a setup take?

It depends on the scope. A focused reply and follow-up system is quicker than a full booking and AI setup. You will get a clear timeline on the free call.

Does my team need training?

Only a short walkthrough. Agents mostly see alerts and a simple lead board.

How much does it cost?

It depends on what you need. Book a free call and you will get a clear quote.

What do you need from us?

Access to where your leads arrive today and a short chat about how your team handles them.

Ready to stop losing leads?

Tell us how your leads arrive today. We will show you exactly what can be automated. No technical knowledge needed.
